form.label: Auditor - AE Program Rollup
form.description: One view of what every team is tracking for each acquired entity: data catalog, SIEM contracts, CIM normalization, CIRT detections and telemetry intake. "Measured" figures come from Splunk now. "Workbook" figures come from the lead auditor's AE_Log_Source_Matrix workbook (dc_ae_program lookup). Open "How these numbers are built" at the bottom for every definition and source.

search.query: | `dc_auditor_rollup`
| fillnull value="-" wave lob | search wave="$wave$" lob="$lob$" uhgid="$ae$" plan_status="$plan$"
| inputlookup dc_ae_program | stats count by wave | where wave!="" | eval label="Wave ".wave | sort wave
| inputlookup dc_ae_program | stats count by lob | where lob!="" | sort lob
| eval label=ae_name." (".uhgid.")" | sort ae_name | fields label uhgid

| inputlookup dc_index_retention_lookup | eval idx_group=case(rule_id="AE_TENANT","AE tenant", rule_id="CORE","Core", rule_id="ES_KEY","Enterprise Security", match(index,"^_"),"Splunk internal", 1=1,"Other (no rule)") | eval group_order=case(idx_group="AE tenant",1, idx_group="Core",2, idx_group="Enterprise Security",3, idx_group="Splunk internal",4, 1=1,5) | eval check_order=case(retention_check="BELOW STANDARD",1, retention_check="AT RISK - size cap",2, retention_check="REVIEW - Splunk archive",3, retention_check="CONFIRM ARCHIVE",4, retention_check="LONGER THAN STANDARD",5, retention_check="Meets standard",6, 1=1,7) | fillnull value="-" uhgid ae_name | table index idx_group group_order uhgid ae_name rule_id retention_check check_order searchable_days max_searchable_days required_searchable_days archive_provider archive_days total_retention_days long_term_store earliest_event data_age_days current_size_gb max_size_gb size_used_pct event_count datasets catalog_retention_days findings checked
| search idx_group="$ret_group$" uhgid="$ret_ae$" index="$ret_name$"
| search idx_group="$ret_group$" uhgid="$ret_ae$" index="$ret_name$" | where "$ret_status$"="all" OR ("$ret_status$"="attention" AND check_order<=5) OR retention_check="$ret_status$"
| stats count

single.title: Behind plan

search.query: | where plan_status="Behind plan" | stats count

single.option: a planned phase end has passed, phase not 100%

search.query: | stats sum(flowing) as f, sum(datasets) as d | eval pct=if(d>0,round(f/d*100,1),0) | fields pct
| stats sum(g1) as n, sum(datasets) as d | eval pct=if(d>0,round(n/d*100,1),0) | fields pct

single.title: Detection complete

search.query: | stats sum(g2) as n, sum(datasets) as d | eval pct=if(d>0,round(n/d*100,1),0) | fields pct

single.option: gate 2, measured or set, incl. not needed

search.query: | stats sum(g3) as n, sum(datasets) as d | eval pct=if(d>0,round(n/d*100,1),0) | fields pct

single.title: SIEM contract complete

search.query: | stats sum(siem_done) as n, sum(datasets) as d | eval pct=if(d>0,round(n/d*100,1),0) | fields pct

single.option: datasets with a completed contract (own or shared)

panel.title: Rollup by acquired entity - measured in Splunk now (% complete by phase)

search.query: | sort wave ae_name | table ae_name uhgid wave lob tracked_by datasets m_discovery m_ingest m_splunk2 m_normalize m_detection m_soc m_siem_contract m_cde m_cim_onboarded m_overall req_gaps intake_open plan_status next_milestone days_to_signoff | rename ae_name as "AE", uhgid as "UHGID", wave as "Wave", lob as "LOB", tracked_by as "Tracked in", datasets as "Datasets", m_discovery as "Discovery %", m_ingest as "Ingest 24h %", m_splunk2 as "Splunk 2.0 scope %", m_normalize as "Normalize %", m_detection as "Detection %", m_soc as "SOC %", m_siem_contract as "SIEM contract %", m_cde as "CDE approved %", m_cim_onboarded as "CIM fully onboarded %", m_overall as "Overall %", req_gaps as "Required gaps", intake_open as "Open intake", plan_status as "Plan", next_milestone as "Next milestone", days_to_signoff as "Days to sign-off"
| where wave!="-" | eval wave="Wave ".wave | stats avg(m_ingest) as "Log ingest", avg(m_normalize) as "Normalize", avg(m_detection) as "Detection", avg(m_soc) as "SOC" by wave | sort wave

panel.title: Progress over time (daily snapshot, DC-103; gate automation counts saved from v0.7.4)

search.query: index=summary_datacatalog source="dc_auditor_rollup" | fillnull value="-" wave lob | search wave="$wave$" lob="$lob$" uhgid="$ae$" | eval day=relative_time(_time,"@d") | eventstats max(snapshot) as last_snapshot by day | where snapshot=last_snapshot | eval _time=day | timechart span=1d avg(m_ingest) as "Log ingest", avg(m_normalize) as "Normalize", avg(m_detection) as "Detection", avg(m_soc) as "SOC", avg(m_overall) as "Overall"

panel.title: Plan tracking - phases past their planned end date that are not complete

search.query: | where plan_status!="No plan dates" | eval sort_key=if(plan_status="Behind plan",0,1) | sort sort_key wave ae_name | table ae_name uhgid wave plan_status overdue_phases next_milestone plan_signoff_end days_to_signoff plan_cloud_migration_end plan_overall_complete | rename ae_name as "AE", uhgid as "UHGID", wave as "Wave", plan_status as "Plan", overdue_phases as "Overdue phases (planned end)", next_milestone as "Next milestone", plan_signoff_end as "On-prem sign-off planned", days_to_signoff as "Days to sign-off", plan_cloud_migration_end as "Cloud migration end", plan_overall_complete as "Overall complete planned"

panel.title: Workbook vs Splunk - where the auditor's tracker and the measured figures disagree

search.query: | where tracked_by="workbook + catalog" | foreach normalize detection soc [ eval d_<<FIELD>>=round(m_<<FIELD>>-tonumber(wb_<<FIELD>>_pct),1) ] | eval d_overall=round(m_overall-tonumber(wb_overall_pct),1) | eval largest_gap=max(abs(d_normalize),abs(d_detection),abs(d_soc)), check=case(isnull(largest_gap),"no comparison", largest_gap>10,"DIFFERS BY MORE THAN 10 PTS", 1=1,"within 10 pts") | sort - largest_gap | table ae_name uhgid wave wb_normalize_pct m_normalize d_normalize wb_detection_pct m_detection d_detection wb_soc_pct m_soc d_soc wb_overall_pct m_overall check workbook_as_of | rename ae_name as "AE", uhgid as "UHGID", wave as "Wave", wb_normalize_pct as "Normalize (workbook)", m_normalize as "Normalize (Splunk)", d_normalize as "Normalize delta", wb_detection_pct as "Detection (workbook)", m_detection as "Detection (Splunk)", d_detection as "Detection delta", wb_soc_pct as "SOC (workbook)", m_soc as "SOC (Splunk)", d_soc as "SOC delta", wb_overall_pct as "Overall (workbook)", m_overall as "Overall (Splunk)", check as "Check", workbook_as_of as "Workbook as of"

panel.title: Tracker consistency findings - records that do not line up across sources

search.query: | `dc_auditor_rollup` | fillnull value="-" wave lob | search wave="$wave$" lob="$lob$" uhgid="$ae$" | eval finding=mvappend( if(wave_check!="", "Wave differs between workbook sheets: ".wave_check, null()), if(tracked_by="workbook only", "In the auditor workbook but no datasets in the catalog", null()), if(tracked_by="catalog only", "In the catalog but not in the auditor workbook", null()), if(tracked_by!="catalog only" AND (isnull(plan_signoff_end) OR plan_signoff_end=""), "No plan dates in the workbook timeline", null())) | append [| inputlookup dc_splunk2_allow | eval uhgid=lower(id) | where uhgid!="core" | lookup dc_datasets_lookup uhgid OUTPUT dataset_id | where isnull(dataset_id) | eval ae_name=name, finding="On the Splunk 2.0 allow list but no datasets in the catalog"] | mvexpand finding | where isnotnull(finding) | table ae_name uhgid wave finding | sort finding ae_name | rename ae_name as "AE", uhgid as "UHGID", wave as "Wave", finding as "Finding"

panel.title: Index retention - ES indexes 3 years or longer; AE and core indexes 90 days in Splunk, long-term copy in AWS S3

search.query: | where idx_group="AE tenant" | stats count by uhgid ae_name | eval label=if(ae_name="-",uhgid,ae_name." (".uhgid.")")." - ".count." indexes" | sort ae_name | fields label uhgid

html.p: Start with the summary below: click a row to list that group's (or AE's) indexes. "Needs attention" hides indexes that meet their rule; pick "All statuses" to see every index in the group.

| where retention_check="BELOW STANDARD" | stats count

div.p: Every Measured percentage uses the catalog dataset (tenant x sourcetype) as the unit, the same grain as the workbook's source-type rows.

ul.li: Discovery % - required federated log-source requirements for the AE that have data cataloged or flowing (DC-60). Where DC-60 has no rows for the AE, Overall uses the workbook's Discovery figure instead.
Ingest 24h % - cataloged datasets with events in the last 24 hours.
Splunk 2.0 scope % - datasets covered by CIRT's Splunk 2.0 allow list (pulled from GitHub).

Normalize / Detection / SOC % - catalog gates 1, 2 and 3. As in the workbook, Detection and SOC count Complete, No Detection Needed and Covered as done. Gates 1 and 2 are measured daily by DC-45 and the further-along of the measured and person-entered value is used, so a gate set by a person is never lowered: Normalize is Complete when the dataset's best CIM coverage score is 50 or more (the same rule as the CIM Command Center); Detection is Covered when an enabled, healthy correlation search reads the dataset directly or through a CIM data model it is normalized into. SOC cannot be measured from Splunk and stays person-entered.

SIEM contract % / CDE approved % - datasets with a completed SIEM contract / CDE approval in the contract master, for this tenant's index or shared from another AE or Core that holds a contract for the same sourcetype. Every contracted dataset is cataloged automatically (DC-00f, every 2 hours), so new datasets join these counts without a seed-file change.
CIM fully onboarded % - the AE's sourcetypes in the "Fully onboarded" status on the latest CIM Command Center snapshot.
Overall % - the average of Discovery, Ingest, Normalize, Detection and SOC. The workbook's Overall also averages Monitoring Live, which Splunk cannot measure, so expect the two to differ.

Retention check - each index's settings (DC-104, daily) against its rule in dc_retention_policy. ES_KEY (every Enterprise Security index: notable, risk, threat_activity, cim_modactions, audit_summary, ueba and the rest): kept in Splunk 3 years or longer. AE_TENANT (sec_*_uhgid-NNNNNN) and CORE (sec_*_core): 90 days hot in Splunk with no Splunk archive; edge processors send the long-term copy to AWS S3, which Splunk cannot see. AT RISK - size cap: 90% or more of the size limit and the oldest event is younger than the retention, so data is leaving by size. REVIEW - Splunk archive: a Splunk archive is set on an index whose long-term copy belongs in S3. LONGER THAN STANDARD: searchable longer than the rule (a cost question, not a gap). No rule: no rule matches the index name yet.
Behind plan - a phase's planned end date (workbook timeline, on-prem path) has passed and the phase is below 100%.

div.p: Workbook figures are a point-in-time copy (see "Workbook as of"). To refresh them, regenerate lookups/dc_ae_program_seed.csv from the workbook, or turn on the auditor_program GitHub pull.
